name: codeship-steps

name.description: The name of the step. Can be omitted.

type.description: The type of the step. If omitted, defaults to 'run'

tag.description: A pattern matching tags or branches this step and any of its children should be run against. Defaults to always running.

exclude.description: A pattern matching tags or branches on which this step should NOT be run. Defaults to empty.

service.description: The service name defined in codeship-services.yml this step will run on

services.description: A list of service names defined in codeship-services.yml that will be used for this step.

command.description: The command to be run in this step. Required with and can only be used with the 'run' type or no specified type

steps.description: A list of steps to run within this step or on_fail group. Cannot be used with 'run', 'push', or 'load' steps

image_name.description: The image name this push step should push to. Required with and only used by the push step

image_tag.description: The image tag this push step should push to. See https://docs.cloudbees.com/docs/cloudbees-codeship/latest/pro-builds-and-configuration/steps#_push_steps for details. Only used by the push step

registry.description: The image registry this push step should push to. For Docker Hub, use https://registry-1.docker.io. Required with and only used by the push step

encrypted_dockercfg_path.description: The location of a Docker configuration file encrypted by Jet to be used with this step. Optional.

dockercfg_service.description: The name of a service defined in codeship-services.yml that provides the Docker configuration. Optional.

on_fail.description: An optional list of steps to run if this step fails.

schema.description: codeship-steps.yml is where you configure each step to run in your CI/CD builds with CodeShip.
schema.title: CodeShip Pro steps configuration

description:
Our CI pipeline begins with an **Install Dependencies** step that runs on the **builder** service, executing `npm ci`. Once the environment is ready, we push the Docker image `myorg/myapp` to Docker Hub (`https://registry-1.docker.io`) using the **Push Docker Image** step; the image is tagged **v1.2.3**. The next phase, **Test Suite**, is a serial group that first runs **Unit Tests** on the builder service with `npm test --unit`, followed by **Integration Tests** on the same service with `npm test --integration`.

After testing, we perform linting and security scanning in parallel. The **Lint and Security Scan** step runs **ESLint** on the builder service (`npm run lint`) while simultaneously running a **Security Scan** on the scanner service (`snyk test`). Finally, deployment to production is a manual step triggered only on branches matching `release/*`. The **Deploy to Production** step runs the **Deploy Script** on the deployer service (`./deploy.sh`). If this deployment fails, the pipeline automatically executes a **Rollback** step—also on the deployer service—by running `./rollback.sh`.
